releases.notes:
# Essor - Revamped - v1.1.0

> Less complexity for a complete focus on the core levelling system.

- Removed the mastery level mechanic ;
- Removed the experience multiplier mechanic ;
- Nerfed levelling threshold accordingly :
    - Previous formula : `25 + (<level> * 25)` ;
    - New formula : `50 + (<level> * 50)`.
- Levelling up an item now restores 25% of its durability.
- Added a compatibility with "Mod Menu".
- Added new settings thanks to "Mod Menu"'s API :
    - Added a setting to control whether the toast notification when an equipment gains experience should display or not.
    - Added a setting to control whether the toast notification when an equipment levels up should display or not.

Have fun with this new update, I wanted to lighten the whole thing, 'cauase it looked so heavy both to understand as a player and to maintain for me, as I am still new to Fabric, lol. *Bisous.*
